faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and make the payment for the RITES Assistant Manager position is 08 October 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time bachelor's degree in any branch of engineering and a full-time two-year MBA (or equivalent) with a specialization in Finance or related subjects to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any work experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience is required. This experience should be in areas such as transaction advisory, financial modeling, project finance, or investment banking, among others.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Manager position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Manager post is 32 years. Age relaxations are applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Manager post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Manager / Transaction Advisory position announced by RITES in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Manager post will receive a salary in the pay scale of INR 40,000 to INR 1,40,000 per month, along with various allowances and benefits.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RITES Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by Document Scrutiny, and finally an Interview. The written test will consist of 125 objective-type questions.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the RITES Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official RITES website. The application window is open from 17 September 2026 to 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for the RITES Assistant Manager application?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 600/- plus applicable taxes, while EWS/SC/ST/PwBD candidates are required to pay Rs. 300/- plus applicable taxes as the application fee.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
